market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower over 1–3 months as RBA rate fears, fuel shock, and housing stress cap upside. Tech and energy provide pockets of strength. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US election-driven energy price swings.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: structural iron ore decline, fiscal debt cliff, and El Niño agricultural risk weigh on growth. Gold/rare-earth exploration and AI capex offer selective upside. Rate peak likely within 12 months, supporting a late-cycle recovery in housing and consumer.
